description:
The Start 24" continues our mission of making low maintenance bicycles that help your kids ride confidently and comfortably with:

Rust & Grease Free Gates Belt Drive

Multi-Terrain Tires so your rider can go anywhere

Adjustable Angle Stem so the bike can grow with your child

3-speed Shimano Hub & Grip Shifter to hit hills and cruise down the bike path without getting tired (equivalent gear range to a 7-speed derailleur bike)

Low-step Aluminum Frame for rust-free, lightweight comfort, and ease of mounting/dismounting

All-Weather Grips & Seat for comfort and durability

Dual Hand Brakes for safe, confident stopping power

Kickstand included

A composite belt guard is installed with every bicycle

Full reflector kit: Front, Rear, Wheels, Pedals

A Wide Color Selection to fit your child's interest

Seat Height: 27" - 34.5". This bicycle generally fits children 7-13 years old. To confirm that this bicycle is right for your child, measure their inseam (shoes off, ground to top of crotch). Note that novice riders will ride flat-footed, while advanced riders will be able to balance at a stop on their toes.

For novice riders, the seat height and inseam range are the same, this fits children with a 27 - 34.5" inseam.
For advanced riders, the seat should be approx. 1.5" taller, and thus this bike will fit children with a 25.5 - 33" inseam.

Have a child a little too young for the 24”? Get them started on the Start 20”!
